FAQs

What is your MOQ?

Standard SKUs have an MOQ of 50-100pcs; custom mold MOQ is 300pcs. Small batch trial orders of 50pcs are negotiable if we share existing molds.

Is KeXinMaterials a factory or a trading company?

KeXinMaterials (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. is a source factory with an 18,000㎡ facility. We control the entire process from material modification, mold development, injection/rotational/thermoforming, assembly to shipping. Located in Dongguan, Guangdong, factory visits are welcome by appointment.

What does IP67 mean? How deep can it go?

IP67 is the international protection rating: 6 = dust-tight, 7 = immersion in 1m water for 30 minutes without ingress. Our IP67 cases pass IEC 60529. For deeper underwater use, IP68 (5-30m) is available.

How to choose explosion-proof rating?

Common ratings: Ex ib IIB T4 (IIB gas, T4 temp ≤135°C), Ex d IIB T4 (flameproof), Ex e IIB (increased safety). Li-battery transport typically uses Ex ib IIB T4. Contact kexin@beeaa.com for certified solutions.

What certifications do nucleic acid sample cases need?

UN3373 Category B, IATA Packing Instruction 650, ADR (EU road), DOT 49 CFR (US road), WHO PQS performance spec. We provide primary + secondary + outer packaging 3-layer solution.
